findings.detail: Gainwell's source spread is S + 410, while the flagged extracted identifier says S+400.

rationale: Class 2 review of the identified source rows shows a structured S-plus-spread rate in every checked row, directly contradicting the rule mechanism ref_SOFR_no_structured_spread; the reference-corroboration flag is therefore a false alarm.
